from pathlib import Path
from html import escape
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, display

root = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "reports" else Path.cwd()
processed = root / "data" / "processed"
config = json.loads((root / "config" / "league.json").read_text())
branding = pd.read_csv(root / "config" / "team_branding.csv").fillna("")
categories = pd.read_csv(root / "config" / "categories.csv")
canonical = pd.read_csv(processed / "canonical_player_projections.csv", dtype={"fantrax_player_id": str})
player_value_ratings = pd.read_csv(processed / "player_value_ratings.csv", dtype={"fantrax_player_id": str})
team_outlook = pd.read_csv(processed / "team_outlook.csv", dtype={"fantasy_team_id": str}).set_index("fantasy_team_id")
player_team_chemistry = pd.read_csv(
    processed / "player_team_chemistry.csv",
    dtype={"fantrax_player_id": str, "current_team_id": str, "target_team_id": str},
)
player_teammate_chemistry = pd.read_csv(
    processed / "player_teammate_chemistry.csv",
    dtype={"fantrax_player_id": str, "teammate_player_id": str, "fantasy_team_id": str},
)
player_archetypes = pd.read_csv(
    processed / "player_archetypes.csv", dtype={"fantrax_player_id": str, "fantasy_team_id": str},
)
hierarchical_cluster_summary = pd.read_csv(processed / "hierarchical_cluster_summary.csv")
player_rating_columns = [column for column in player_value_ratings.columns if column.startswith("rating_") or column == "overall_rating"]
canonical = canonical.merge(
    player_value_ratings[["fantrax_player_id", *player_rating_columns]],
    on="fantrax_player_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one",
)
current_player_chemistry = player_team_chemistry[
    player_team_chemistry["current_team_id"].eq(player_team_chemistry["target_team_id"])
][["fantrax_player_id", "player_chemistry"]]
canonical = canonical.merge(
    current_player_chemistry,
    on="fantrax_player_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one",
)
category_summary = pd.read_csv(processed / "league_category_summary.csv").set_index("category")
category_cowin = pd.read_csv(processed / "league_category_cowin.csv", index_col=0)
historical_matchups = pd.read_parquet(processed / "historical_matchups.parquet")
nba_schedule = pd.read_csv(processed / "nba_schedule.csv")
counting_models = pd.read_csv(processed / "counting_logistic_models.csv").set_index("category")
counting_curves = pd.read_csv(processed / "counting_logistic_curves.csv")
counting_bins = pd.read_csv(processed / "counting_logistic_bins.csv")
shooting_models = pd.read_csv(processed / "shooting_logistic_models.csv").set_index("category")
shooting_curves = pd.read_csv(processed / "shooting_logistic_curves.csv")
shooting_bins = pd.read_csv(processed / "shooting_logistic_bins.csv")
overall_model = pd.read_csv(processed / "overall_logistic_model.csv").iloc[0]
overall_coefficients = pd.read_csv(processed / "overall_logistic_coefficients.csv").set_index("category")
overall_calibration = pd.read_csv(processed / "overall_logistic_calibration.csv")
season_backtest_summary = pd.read_csv(processed / "season_backtest_summary.csv")
season_backtest_folds = pd.read_csv(processed / "season_backtest_folds.csv")
season_backtest_calibration = pd.read_csv(processed / "season_backtest_calibration.csv")

historical_regular_schedule = nba_schedule[
    pd.to_numeric(nba_schedule["sbc_year"], errors="coerce").between(2021, 2026)
    & nba_schedule["Season"].eq("Regular")
    & nba_schedule["Period"].notna()
]
period_nba_games = historical_regular_schedule.groupby(["sbc_year", "Period"])["nba_game_id"].nunique()

category_order = categories["category"].tolist()
category_summary = category_summary.reindex(category_order)
category_cowin = category_cowin.reindex(index=category_order, columns=category_order)

def number(value, decimals=0):
    if pd.isna(value) or value == 0:
        return ""
    return f"{value:,.{decimals}f}"

def signed_number(value, decimals=1):
    if pd.isna(value) or value == 0:
        return ""
    return f"{value:+,.{decimals}f}"

def projection_with_rating(value, rating):
    projection = escape(str(value)) if str(value) else "&nbsp;"
    if pd.isna(rating):
        return f'<div class="stat-cell"><span>{projection}</span><span class="rating-pill is-empty">&nbsp;</span></div>'
    emphasis = " is-high" if rating >= 8 else " is-low" if rating < 3 else ""
    return f'<div class="stat-cell"><span>{projection}</span><span class="rating-pill{emphasis}">{rating:.1f}</span></div>'

def overall_rating_pill(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return '<div class="overall-player-rating is-empty">&nbsp;</div>'
    emphasis = " is-high" if value >= 8 else " is-low" if value < 3 else ""
    return f'<div class="overall-player-rating{emphasis}">{value:.1f}</div>'

def chemistry_rating_pill(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return '<div class="chemistry-player-rating is-empty">&nbsp;</div>'
    return f'<div class="chemistry-player-rating">{value:.1f}</div>'

def ordinal(value):
    value = int(value)
    suffix = "th" if 10 <= value % 100 <= 20 else {1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd"}.get(value % 10, "th")
    return f"{value}{suffix}"

def team_metric_tiles(team_id):
    outlook = team_outlook.loc[str(team_id)]
    chemistry_level = float(outlook["chemistry_level"])
    return f"""
    <div class="metric-grid">
      <article><small>Skill Level</small><strong>{float(outlook['skill_probability']):.1%}</strong></article>
      <article><small>Expected Score</small><strong>{float(outlook['expected_score']):.1f}</strong></article>
      <article><small>Team Chemistry</small><strong>{chemistry_level:.1f}</strong></article>
      <article><small>League Rank</small><strong>{ordinal(outlook['league_rank'])}</strong></article>
    </div>"""

def team_category_chart(team_id):
    outlook = team_outlook.loc[str(team_id)]
    chart_width, chart_height = 1240, 330
    left, right, top, bottom = 54, 18, 24, 58
    plot_width = chart_width - left - right
    plot_height = chart_height - top - bottom
    total_weight = float(categories["weight"].sum())
    x = left
    bars, labels, values = [], [], []
    for row in categories.itertuples(index=False):
        category = row.category
        probability = float(outlook[f"probability_{category}"])
        width = plot_width * float(row.weight) / total_weight
        height = plot_height * probability
        y = top + plot_height - height
        bars.append(
            f'<rect class="weighted-category-bar" x="{x:.2f}" y="{y:.2f}" width="{width:.2f}" height="{height:.2f}">'
            f'<title>{escape(category)} · {probability:.1%} win probability · {int(row.weight)} points</title></rect>'
        )
        labels.append(
            f'<text class="weighted-category-label" x="{x + width / 2:.2f}" y="{chart_height - 32}" text-anchor="middle">{escape(category)}</text>'
        )
        values.append(
            f'<text class="weighted-category-value" x="{x + width / 2:.2f}" y="{max(top + 13, y - 7):.2f}" text-anchor="middle">{probability:.0%}</text>'
        )
        x += width
    grid = []
    for probability in [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]:
        y = top + plot_height * (1 - probability)
        line = "" if probability == .5 else f'<line class="weighted-category-grid" x1="{left}" y1="{y:.2f}" x2="{chart_width - right}" y2="{y:.2f}"></line>'
        grid.append(
            line + f'<text class="weighted-category-axis" x="{left - 9}" y="{y + 4:.2f}" text-anchor="end">{probability:.0%}</text>'
        )
    return f"""<div class="weighted-category-card">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 {chart_width} {chart_height}" role="img" aria-label="Projected category win probabilities with bar widths proportional to SBCFBL category weights">
        {''.join(grid)}{''.join(bars)}{''.join(values)}{''.join(labels)}
      </svg>
    </div>"""

def player_fit_boards(team_id):
    team_id = str(team_id)
    candidates = player_team_chemistry[
        player_team_chemistry["target_team_id"].eq(team_id)
        & player_team_chemistry["current_team_id"].ne(team_id)
    ].copy()
    candidates = candidates.merge(
        player_value_ratings[["fantrax_player_id", "overall_rating"]],
        on="fantrax_player_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one",
    ).dropna(subset=["team_fit_score", "player_chemistry", "overall_rating"])
    candidates = candidates[candidates["overall_rating"].ge(5.0)]

    def fit_table(frame, ascending):
        frame = frame.sort_values(
            ["team_fit_score", "player_chemistry", "skill_impact_pp"],
            ascending=[ascending, ascending, ascending],
        ).head(8)
        rows = "".join(
            f"<tr><td>{escape(row.player_name)}</td><td>{escape(row.current_team_name)}</td>"
            f"<td>{row.overall_rating:.1f}</td><td>{row.player_chemistry:.1f}</td><td>{row.team_fit_score:.1f}</td></tr>"
            for row in frame.itertuples(index=False)
        )
        return f"""<table class="fit-board-table"><thead><tr><th>Player</th><th>From</th><th>Ovr</th><th>Chemistry</th><th>Fit</th></tr></thead><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>"""

    return f"""<div class="fit-board-grid">
      <section><h3>Players To Add</h3>{fit_table(candidates, False)}</section>
      <section><h3>Players To Avoid</h3>{fit_table(candidates, True)}</section>
      <section class="category-bar-panel"><h3>Category Win Profile</h3>{team_category_chart(team_id)}</section>
    </div>"""

def percentage(value):
    if pd.isna(value) or value == 0:
        return ""
    return f"{value:.1%}"

def overview_kpis():
    completed_seasons = historical_matchups["Year"].nunique()
    current_nba_games = int(pd.to_numeric(nba_schedule["sbc_year"], errors="coerce").eq(2027).sum())
    return f"""
    <div class="overview-kpis">
      <article><small>Completed Seasons</small><strong>{completed_seasons}</strong><span>2021–2026 frozen history</span></article>
      <article><small>SBCFBL Matchups</small><strong>{len(historical_matchups):,}</strong><span>regular season and postseason</span></article>
      <article><small>NBA Games Archived</small><strong>{len(nba_schedule):,}</strong><span>{current_nba_games:,} on the 2026–27 schedule</span></article>
    </div>"""

def archetype_overview():
    rated = player_archetypes[player_archetypes["archetype_label"].ne("Unrated")]
    return f"""<section class="archetype-overview">
      <div class="archetype-overview-kpis">
        <article><small>Players Classified</small><strong>{len(rated)}</strong></article>
        <article><small>Named Archetypes</small><strong>8</strong></article>
        <article><small>Observed Labels</small><strong>{rated['archetype_label'].nunique()} / 64</strong></article>
        <article><small>Ward Branches</small><strong>{rated['hierarchical_cluster'].nunique()}</strong></article>
      </div>
      <div class="archetype-method-note"><strong>Two complementary lenses</strong><span>Named archetypes explain <em>how</em> a player creates fantasy value. Ward branches answer <em>who actually looks alike</em> when category ratings, projected totals, and per-36 production are considered together.</span></div>
    </section>"""

ARCHETYPE_COLORS = {
    "Do-It-All Superstar": "#d99a16",
    "Star To Build Around": "#7759a8",
    "Role Player": "#3f78a8",
    "Specialist": "#d65f59",
    "Minute Filler": "#6f8f3d",
    "Negative Player": "#8f4852",
    "Bench Warmer": "#8793a2",
    "Sleeper": "#22a18a",
}
ARCHETYPE_SCORE_KEYS = {
    "Do-It-All Superstar": "do_it_all_superstar",
    "Star To Build Around": "star_to_build_around",
    "Role Player": "role_player",
    "Specialist": "specialist",
    "Minute Filler": "minute_filler",
    "Negative Player": "negative_player",
    "Bench Warmer": "bench_warmer",
    "Sleeper": "sleeper",
}

def archetype_landscape():
    rated = player_archetypes[
        player_archetypes["archetype_label"].ne("Unrated")
        & player_archetypes["map_x"].notna()
        & player_archetypes["map_y"].notna()
    ].copy()
    width, height = 1180, 650
    left, right, top, bottom = 54, 28, 32, 68
    x_min, x_max = rated["map_x"].min(), rated["map_x"].max()
    y_min, y_max = rated["map_y"].min(), rated["map_y"].max()
    def sx(value):
        return left + (float(value) - x_min) / max(x_max - x_min, 1e-9) * (width - left - right)
    def sy(value):
        return top + (y_max - float(value)) / max(y_max - y_min, 1e-9) * (height - top - bottom)
    grid = []
    for fraction in [.2, .4, .6, .8]:
        x = left + fraction * (width - left - right)
        y = top + fraction * (height - top - bottom)
        grid.extend([
            f'<line class="landscape-grid" x1="{x:.1f}" y1="{top}" x2="{x:.1f}" y2="{height-bottom}"/>',
            f'<line class="landscape-grid" x1="{left}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{width-right}" y2="{y:.1f}"/>',
        ])
    points = []
    for row in rated.sort_values("overall_rating").itertuples(index=False):
        color = ARCHETYPE_COLORS.get(row.primary_archetype, "#64748b")
        radius = 3.1 + 5.8 * max(0, min(10, float(row.overall_rating))) / 10
        point_x, point_y = sx(row.map_x), sy(row.map_y)
        label_left = point_x > width - 230
        label_x = point_x - radius - 7 if label_left else point_x + radius + 7
        label_anchor = "end" if label_left else "start"
        points.append(
            f'<g class="landscape-player"><circle class="landscape-point" cx="{point_x:.1f}" cy="{point_y:.1f}" r="{radius:.1f}" fill="{color}">'
            f'<title>{escape(row.player_name)} · {escape(row.archetype_label)} · Ovr {row.overall_rating:.1f} · Ward Branch {int(row.hierarchical_cluster)}</title></circle>'
            f'<text class="point-hover-label" x="{label_x:.1f}" y="{point_y-9:.1f}" text-anchor="{label_anchor}">{escape(row.player_name)} · {row.overall_rating:.1f}</text></g>'
        )
    centroids = rated.groupby("hierarchical_cluster", as_index=False).agg(
        map_x=("map_x", "mean"), map_y=("map_y", "mean"), players=("player_name", "size")
    )
    branch_labels = "".join(
        f'<g class="branch-marker"><circle cx="{sx(row.map_x):.1f}" cy="{sy(row.map_y):.1f}" r="15"/><text x="{sx(row.map_x):.1f}" y="{sy(row.map_y)+4:.1f}" text-anchor="middle">B{int(row.hierarchical_cluster)}</text></g>'
        for row in centroids.itertuples(index=False)
    )
    stars = rated[rated["primary_archetype"].eq("Do-It-All Superstar")]
    star_labels = "".join(
        f'<text class="star-label" x="{sx(row.map_x)+9:.1f}" y="{sy(row.map_y)-8:.1f}">{escape(row.player_name)}</text>'
        for row in stars.itertuples(index=False)
    )
    legend = "".join(
        f'<span><i style="background:{color}"></i>{escape(label)}</span>'
        for label, color in ARCHETYPE_COLORS.items()
    )
    return f"""<section class="landscape-card">
      <header><div><small>Weighted Feature Space</small><h4>Player Style Landscape</h4></div><p>Nearby dots have similar category shape, opportunity, and per-36 production. Color is the interpretable primary archetype; B1–B12 mark Ward-branch centers. Dot size follows Ovr.</p></header>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-label="Two-dimensional map of projected players by statistical similarity">{''.join(grid)}{''.join(points)}{branch_labels}{star_labels}<text class="landscape-axis" x="{width/2}" y="{height-16}" text-anchor="middle">Principal Component 1 · statistical profile, not quality</text><text class="landscape-axis" transform="translate(16 {height/2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle">Principal Component 2</text></svg>
      <div class="landscape-legend">{legend}</div>
      <footer>PCA compresses the full similarity inputs into two display dimensions. The Ward model and nearest-neighbor search still use every standardized feature.</footer>
    </section>"""

def archetype_mix_visual():
    rated = player_archetypes[player_archetypes["archetype_label"].ne("Unrated")].copy()
    counts = rated["primary_archetype"].value_counts().reindex(ARCHETYPE_COLORS).fillna(0).astype(int)
    max_count = max(int(counts.max()), 1)
    count_rows = "".join(
        f'<div class="mix-row"><span>{escape(label)}</span><div><i style="width:{100*count/max_count:.1f}%;background:{ARCHETYPE_COLORS[label]}"></i></div><strong>{count}</strong></div>'
        for label, count in counts.items()
    )
    subtype_counts = rated.loc[
        rated["primary_archetype"].eq("Specialist") | rated["secondary_archetype"].eq("Specialist"),
        "specialist_subtype",
    ].value_counts()
    subtype_max = max(int(subtype_counts.max()), 1) if len(subtype_counts) else 1
    subtype_rows = "".join(
        f'<div class="subtype-row"><span>{escape(label.replace(" Specialist", ""))}</span><div><i style="width:{100*count/subtype_max:.1f}%"></i></div><strong>{count}</strong></div>'
        for label, count in subtype_counts.items()
    )
    score_columns = [f"score_{key}" for key in ARCHETYPE_SCORE_KEYS.values()]
    matrix = rated.groupby("primary_archetype")[score_columns].median().reindex(ARCHETYPE_COLORS)
    headers = "".join(f'<th title="{escape(label)}">{escape(label.split()[0])}</th>' for label in ARCHETYPE_COLORS)
    heat_rows = []
    for label, row in matrix.iterrows():
        cells = []
        for key in ARCHETYPE_SCORE_KEYS.values():
            value = float(row[f"score_{key}"])
            alpha = .08 + .84 * value / 100
            cells.append(f'<td style="background:rgba(18,58,104,{alpha:.3f});color:{"#fff" if value >= 55 else "#142033"}">{value:.0f}</td>')
        heat_rows.append(f'<tr><th>{escape(label)}</th>{"".join(cells)}</tr>')
    return f"""<div class="archetype-viz-grid">
      <section class="archetype-viz-card"><header><small>Primary Identity</small><h4>Who Is In Each Archetype?</h4></header><div class="mix-bars">{count_rows}</div></section>
      <section class="archetype-viz-card"><header><small>K-Means Shape</small><h4>What Kind Of Specialists?</h4></header><div class="subtype-bars">{subtype_rows}</div><p>Includes players with Specialist as either their primary or secondary identity.</p></section>
      <section class="archetype-viz-card archetype-fingerprint"><header><small>Median Membership Score</small><h4>Archetype Fingerprints</h4></header><div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Primary Archetype</th>{headers}</tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(heat_rows)}</tbody></table></div></section>
    </div>"""

def specialist_kmeans_explainer():
    rated = player_archetypes[player_archetypes["archetype_label"].ne("Unrated")].copy()
    specialists = rated[
        rated["primary_archetype"].eq("Specialist")
        | rated["secondary_archetype"].eq("Specialist")
    ]
    subtype_counts = specialists["specialist_subtype"].value_counts()
    subtype_descriptions = {
        "Shooting Specialist": "TS%, 2PT%, 3PT%, and FT% shape",
        "Scoring Specialist": "minutes and points production",
        "Playmaking Specialist": "assists with turnover control",
        "Defensive Specialist": "steals, blocks, and +/- impact",
        "Interior Specialist": "rebounds, rim efficiency, and blocks",
    }
    subtype_cards = "".join(
        f"""<article><span>{int(subtype_counts.get(label, 0))} Players</span><strong>{escape(label)}</strong><small>{escape(description)}</small></article>"""
        for label, description in subtype_descriptions.items()
    )
    return f"""<section class="specialist-explainer">
      <header><div><small>Unsupervised Subtyping</small><h4>How Specialist K-Means Works</h4></div><p>K-means is used only after the interpretable Specialist score identifies concentrated category value. It describes the <em>shape</em> of that specialization; it does not decide whether the player is good.</p></header>
      <div class="specialist-process">
        <article><b>1</b><div><strong>Build Five Domains</strong><span>The 13 category ratings are summarized into shooting, scoring, playmaking, defense, and interior production.</span></div></article>
        <article><b>2</b><div><strong>Remove General Talent</strong><span>Each player's five-domain average is subtracted. Jokic cannot become every specialist simply because he is elite everywhere.</span></div></article>
        <article><b>3</b><div><strong>Cluster The Shape</strong><span>Standardized profiles with Specialist scores of at least 50 train a deterministic five-cluster K-means model.</span></div></article>
        <article><b>4</b><div><strong>Name The Centroids</strong><span>The five centroids are matched one-to-one with the five basketball meanings using the strongest total domain alignment.</span></div></article>
      </div>
      <div class="specialist-type-cards">{subtype_cards}</div>
      <footer><strong>Reading the result:</strong> “Shooting Specialist” means shooting is the player's most distinctive concentration relative to their own overall profile. The player's Ovr and category ratings still determine how valuable that specialization is.</footer>
    </section>"""

SPECIALIST_COLORS = {
    "Shooting Specialist": "#9b59b6",
    "Scoring Specialist": "#df6b3f",
    "Playmaking Specialist": "#2878b5",
    "Defensive Specialist": "#2d8b73",
    "Interior Specialist": "#c29428",
}

def specialist_cluster_map():
    rating_fields = [f"rating_{category}" for category in category_order]
    frame = player_archetypes.merge(
        player_value_ratings[["fantrax_player_id", *rating_fields]],
        on="fantrax_player_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one",
    )
    frame = frame[
        frame["score_specialist"].ge(50)
        & frame["specialist_subtype"].isin(SPECIALIST_COLORS)
    ].copy()
    domains = pd.DataFrame({
        "Shooting": frame[["rating_TS%", "rating_2PT%", "rating_3PT%", "rating_FT%"]].mean(axis=1),
        "Scoring": frame[["rating_MP", "rating_PTS"]].mean(axis=1),
        "Playmaking": frame[["rating_AST", "rating_TOV"]].mean(axis=1),
        "Defense": frame[["rating_STL", "rating_BLK", "rating_+/-"]].mean(axis=1),
        "Interior": frame[["rating_OREB", "rating_DREB", "rating_2PT%", "rating_BLK"]].mean(axis=1),
    }, index=frame.index)
    shaped = domains.sub(domains.mean(axis=1), axis=0)
    standardized = shaped.sub(shaped.mean()).div(shaped.std().replace(0, 1))
    centered = standardized.to_numpy() - standardized.to_numpy().mean(axis=0)
    u, singular_values, _ = np.linalg.svd(centered, full_matrices=False)
    frame["cluster_x"] = u[:, 0] * singular_values[0]
    frame["cluster_y"] = u[:, 1] * singular_values[1]

    width, height = 1160, 650
    left, right, top, bottom = 45, 32, 26, 70
    x_min, x_max = frame["cluster_x"].min(), frame["cluster_x"].max()
    y_min, y_max = frame["cluster_y"].min(), frame["cluster_y"].max()
    def sx(value):
        return left + (float(value) - x_min) / max(x_max - x_min, 1e-9) * (width - left - right)
    def sy(value):
        return top + (y_max - float(value)) / max(y_max - y_min, 1e-9) * (height - top - bottom)

    grid = []
    for fraction in [.2, .4, .6, .8]:
        x = left + fraction * (width - left - right)
        y = top + fraction * (height - top - bottom)
        grid.extend([
            f'<line class="specialist-grid" x1="{x:.1f}" y1="{top}" x2="{x:.1f}" y2="{height-bottom}"/>',
            f'<line class="specialist-grid" x1="{left}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{width-right}" y2="{y:.1f}"/>',
        ])

    centroids = frame.groupby("specialist_subtype", as_index=False).agg(
        cluster_x=("cluster_x", "mean"), cluster_y=("cluster_y", "mean"), players=("player_name", "size")
    )
    centroid_lookup = {
        row.specialist_subtype: (sx(row.cluster_x), sy(row.cluster_y))
        for row in centroids.itertuples(index=False)
    }
    envelopes, centroid_marks, connections = [], [], []
    for subtype, group in frame.groupby("specialist_subtype"):
        cx, cy = centroid_lookup[subtype]
        pixel_distances = np.sqrt(
            (group["cluster_x"].map(sx).to_numpy() - cx) ** 2
            + (group["cluster_y"].map(sy).to_numpy() - cy) ** 2
        )
        radius = max(46, min(150, float(np.quantile(pixel_distances, .82)) + 16))
        color = SPECIALIST_COLORS[subtype]
        envelopes.append(f'<circle class="specialist-envelope" cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy:.1f}" r="{radius:.1f}" fill="{color}" stroke="{color}"/>')
        short_label = subtype.replace(" Specialist", "")
        centroid_marks.append(
            f'<g class="specialist-centroid"><circle cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy:.1f}" r="20" fill="{color}"/><text x="{cx:.1f}" y="{cy+4:.1f}" text-anchor="middle">{escape(short_label[:3].upper())}</text></g>'
        )
        connections.extend(
            f'<line class="centroid-link" x1="{sx(row.cluster_x):.1f}" y1="{sy(row.cluster_y):.1f}" x2="{cx:.1f}" y2="{cy:.1f}" stroke="{color}"/>'
            for row in group.itertuples(index=False)
        )

    points = []
    for row in frame.sort_values("overall_rating").itertuples(index=False):
        color = SPECIALIST_COLORS[row.specialist_subtype]
        radius = 3.2 + 3.8 * max(0, min(10, float(row.overall_rating))) / 10
        point_x, point_y = sx(row.cluster_x), sy(row.cluster_y)
        label_left = point_x > width - 250
        label_x = point_x - radius - 7 if label_left else point_x + radius + 7
        label_anchor = "end" if label_left else "start"
        points.append(
            f'<g class="specialist-player"><circle class="specialist-point" cx="{point_x:.1f}" cy="{point_y:.1f}" r="{radius:.1f}" fill="{color}">'
            f'<title>{escape(row.player_name)} · {escape(row.specialist_subtype)} · Specialist Score {row.score_specialist:.1f} · Ovr {row.overall_rating:.1f}</title></circle>'
            f'<text class="point-hover-label" x="{label_x:.1f}" y="{point_y-9:.1f}" text-anchor="{label_anchor}">{escape(row.player_name)} · {escape(row.specialist_subtype.replace(" Specialist", ""))}</text></g>'
        )
    representatives = frame.sort_values("overall_rating", ascending=False).groupby("specialist_subtype", as_index=False).head(1)
    labels = "".join(
        f'<text class="specialist-player-label" x="{sx(row.cluster_x)+8:.1f}" y="{sy(row.cluster_y)-8:.1f}">{escape(row.player_name)}</text>'
        for row in representatives.itertuples(index=False)
    )
    legend = "".join(
        f'<span><i style="background:{color}"></i>{escape(label)} ({int((frame["specialist_subtype"] == label).sum())})</span>'
        for label, color in SPECIALIST_COLORS.items()
    )
    return f"""<section class="specialist-map-card">
      <header><div><small>Five-Domain PCA View</small><h4>Specialist Cluster Map</h4></div><p>Every dot trained the K-means model. Color shows its assigned subtype, size follows Ovr, and the translucent circles summarize each subtype's neighborhood around its centroid.</p></header>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-label="K-means specialist clusters shown as player points around five subtype centroids">{''.join(grid)}{''.join(envelopes)}{''.join(connections)}{''.join(points)}{''.join(centroid_marks)}{labels}<text class="specialist-axis" x="{width/2}" y="{height-17}" text-anchor="middle">Principal Component 1 · relative specialist shape</text><text class="specialist-axis" transform="translate(15 {height/2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle">Principal Component 2</text></svg>
      <div class="specialist-map-legend">{legend}</div>
      <footer>The circles are descriptive 82% envelopes, not hard K-means decision boundaries. Hover over any point for the player, subtype, Specialist score, and Ovr.</footer>
    </section>"""

The examples are the four highest-rated players in each branch.</p></header><div class="branch-card-grid">' + "".join(cards) + '</div></section>'

def heat_color(value):
    value = float(value)
    if value >= 0.5:
        strength = min(1, (value - 0.5) / 0.5)
        start, end = (235, 242, 249), (18, 58, 104)
    else:
        strength = min(1, (0.5 - value) / 0.5)
        start, end = (247, 244, 241), (166, 55, 55)
    color = tuple(round(start[i] + (end[i] - start[i]) * strength) for i in range(3))
    text = "#ffffff" if strength > 0.62 else "#142033"
    return f"rgb{color}", text

def category_cowin_heatmap():
    headers = "".join(f"<th>{escape(category)}</th>" for category in category_order)
    rows = []

            value = float(category_cowin.loc[row_category, column_category])
            background, text = heat_color(value)
            cells.append(
                f'<td style="background:{background};color:{text}" title="{escape(row_category)} and {escape(column_category)}: {value:.1%}">{value:.0%}</td>'
            )
        rows.append(f"<tr><th>{escape(row_category)}</th>{''.join(cells)}</tr>")
    return f"""<div class="macro-card table-scroll"><table class="cowin-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Category</th>{headers}</tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(rows)}</tbody>
    </table></div>"""

def season_backtest_visual():
    order = [*category_order, "Overall"]
    summary = season_backtest_summary.set_index("category").reindex(order).reset_index()
    overall = summary[summary["category"].eq("Overall")].iloc[0]
    width, height = 760, 510
    left, right, top, bottom = 78, 34, 22, 42
    row_height = (height - top - bottom) / len(summary)
    def sx(value):
        return left + (float(value) - .5) / .5 * (width - left - right)
    grid = []
    for value in [.5, .6, .7, .8, .9, 1.0]:
        x = sx(value)
        grid.append(f'<line class="backtest-grid" x1="{x:.1f}" y1="{top}" x2="{x:.1f}" y2="{height-bottom}"/><text class="backtest-axis" x="{x:.1f}" y="{height-15}" text-anchor="middle">{value:.1f}</text>')
    rows = []
    for index, row in enumerate(summary.itertuples(index=False)):
        y = top + row_height * (index + .5)
        color = "#d99a16" if row.category == "Overall" else "#315f8e"
        rows.append(
            f'<text class="backtest-label" x="{left-9}" y="{y+4:.1f}" text-anchor="end">{escape(row.category)}</text>'
            f'<line class="backtest-range" x1="{sx(row.auc_fold_min):.1f}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{sx(row.auc_fold_max):.1f}" y2="{y:.1f}"/>'
            f'<circle class="backtest-dot" cx="{sx(row.auc):.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="6" fill="{color}"><title>{escape(row.category)} · pooled AUC {row.auc:.3f} · season range {row.auc_fold_min:.3f}–{row.auc_fold_max:.3f}</title></circle>'
            f'<text class="backtest-value" x="{sx(row.auc)+10:.1f}" y="{y+4:.1f}">{row.auc:.3f}</text>'
        )

    calibration = season_backtest_calibration[
        season_backtest_calibration["category"].eq("Overall")
    ].sort_values("predicted_probability")
    cal_width, cal_height = 430, 430
    pad = 48
    def cx(value): return pad + float(value) * (cal_width - 2 * pad)
    def cy(value): return cal_height - pad - float(value) * (cal_height - 2 * pad)
    calibration_points = " ".join(
        f'{cx(row.predicted_probability):.1f},{cy(row.observed_win_rate):.1f}'
        for row in calibration.itertuples(index=False)
    )
    cal_grid = []
    for value in [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]:
        cal_grid.extend([
            f'<line class="calibration-grid" x1="{cx(value):.1f}" y1="{pad}" x2="{cx(value):.1f}" y2="{cal_height-pad}"/>',
            f'<line class="calibration-grid" x1="{pad}" y1="{cy(value):.1f}" x2="{cal_width-pad}" y2="{cy(value):.1f}"/>',
            f'<text class="calibration-axis" x="{cx(value):.1f}" y="{cal_height-23}" text-anchor="middle">{value:.0%}</text>',
            f'<text class="calibration-axis" x="{pad-9}" y="{cy(value)+4:.1f}" text-anchor="end">{value:.0%}</text>',
        ])
    cal_dots = "".join(
        f'<circle class="calibration-dot" cx="{cx(row.predicted_probability):.1f}" cy="{cy(row.observed_win_rate):.1f}" r="6"><title>Predicted {row.predicted_probability:.1%} · Observed {row.observed_win_rate:.1%} · {int(row.observations):,} observations</title></circle>'
        for row in calibration.itertuples(index=False)
    )
    table_rows = "".join(
        f'<tr class="{"is-overall" if row.category == "Overall" else ""}"><th>{escape(row.category)}</th><td>{row.auc:.3f}</td><td>{row.auc_fold_min:.3f}–{row.auc_fold_max:.3f}</td><td>{row.brier_score:.3f}</td><td>{row.log_loss:.3f}</td><td>{row.calibration_error:.1%}</td></tr>'
        for row in summary.itertuples(index=False)
    )
    return f"""<section class="backtest-section">
      <div class="backtest-kpis"><article><small>Held-Out Seasons</small><strong>{int(overall.seasons)}</strong></article><article><small>Overall Model AUC</small><strong>{overall.auc:.3f}</strong></article><article><small>Overall Brier Score</small><strong>{overall.brier_score:.3f}</strong></article><article><small>Calibration Error</small><strong>{overall.calibration_error:.1%}</strong></article></div>
      <div class="backtest-chart-grid">
        <article><header><small>Discrimination</small><h4>Pooled Out-Of-Sample AUC</h4><p>Lines show the minimum-to-maximum AUC across the six held-out seasons.</p></header><svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">{''.join(grid)}{''.join(rows)}</svg></article>
        <article><header><small>Probability Accuracy</small><h4>Overall Model Calibration</h4><p>Perfectly calibrated predictions follow the diagonal.</p></header><svg viewBox="0 0 {cal_width} {cal_height}">{''.join(cal_grid)}<line class="calibration-perfect" x1="{pad}" y1="{cal_height-pad}" x2="{cal_width-pad}" y2="{pad}"/><polyline class="calibration-line" points="{calibration_points}"/>{cal_dots}<text class="calibration-title" x="{cal_width/2}" y="{cal_height-5}" text-anchor="middle">Predicted Win Probability</text><text class="calibration-title" transform="translate(12 {cal_height/2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle">Observed Win Rate</text></svg></article>
      </div>
      <div class="table-scroll"><table class="backtest-table"><thead><tr><th>Model</th><th>AUC</th><th>Season AUC Range</th><th>Brier</th><th>Log Loss</th><th>Calibration Error</th></tr></thead><tbody>{table_rows}</tbody></table></div>
    </section>"""

def probability_model_cards(model_table, curve_table, bin_table, model_categories, metric_label, grid_class=""):
    cards = []
    for category in model_categories:
        model = model_table.loc[category]
        curve = curve_table[curve_table["category"].eq(category)]
        observed = bin_table[bin_table["category"].eq(category)]
        x_min, x_max = curve["adjusted_total"].min(), curve["adjusted_total"].max()
        x_span = x_max - x_min or 1
        sx = lambda value: 38 + (float(value) - x_min) / x_span * 264
        sy = lambda value: 178 - float(value) * 142
        path = " ".join(
            ("M" if index == 0 else "L") + f"{sx(row.adjusted_total):.1f},{sy(row.win_probability):.1f}"
            for index, row in enumerate(curve.itertuples(index=False))
        )
        dots = "".join(
            f'<circle cx="{sx(row.adjusted_total):.1f}" cy="{sy(row.observed_win_rate):.1f}" r="3.2"><title>{row.adjusted_total:.1f}: {row.observed_win_rate:.1%} observed ({int(row.observations):,})</title></circle>'
            for row in observed.itertuples(index=False)
        )
        threshold_x = sx(model.threshold_50)
        direction = "Lower Is Better" if category == "TOV" else "Higher Is Better"
        threshold_label = f"{model.threshold_50:+.2f}" if metric_label == "Points gained" else f"{model.threshold_50:.2f}"
        cards.append(f"""
        <article class="logit-card">
          <header><div><small>{direction}</small><h4>{escape(category)}</h4></div><div><small>50% Mark</small><strong>{threshold_label}</strong></div></header>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="{escape(category)} category win probability curve">
            <line class="curve" x1="90" y1="22" x2="108" y2="22"></line><text x="113" y="25">Model curve</text>
            <g class="observed"><circle cx="206" cy="22" r="3.2"></circle></g><text x="213" y="25">Historical results</text>
            <line class="grid" x1="38" y1="107" x2="302" y2="107"></line>
            <line class="threshold" x1="{threshold_x:.1f}" y1="36" x2="{threshold_x:.1f}" y2="178"></line>
            <line class="axis" x1="38" y1="178" x2="302" y2="178"></line><line class="axis" x1="38" y1="36" x2="38" y2="178"></line>
            <path class="curve" d="{path}"></path><g class="observed">{dots}</g>
            <text x="31" y="181" text-anchor="end">0%</text><text x="31" y="110" text-anchor="end">50%</text><text x="31" y="40" text-anchor="end">100%</text>
            <text x="38" y="195" text-anchor="start">{x_min:.1f}</text><text x="170" y="195" text-anchor="middle">{escape(metric_label)} · 24.93 games</text><text x="302" y="195" text-anchor="end">{x_max:.1f}</text>
          </svg>
          <footer><span>AUC <strong>{model.auc:.3f}</strong></span><span>R² <strong>{model.mcfadden_r2:.3f}</strong></span><span>{int(model.matchups):,} matchups</span></footer>
        </article>""")
    grid_style = ' style="grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));max-width:980px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto"' if grid_class else ""
    return f'<div class="logit-grid {grid_class}"{grid_style}>' + "".join(cards) + "</div>"

      </div>
      <div class="calibration-wrap">
        <div><small>Calibration Curve</small><h4>Predicted Chance vs. Actual Results</h4><p>A well-calibrated model follows the dashed diagonal. Each dot is one equally populated band of historical predictions.</p></div>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 680 340" role="img" aria-label="Overall matchup model calibration curve">
          <line class="cal-grid" x1="55" y1="237.5" x2="625" y2="237.5"></line><line class="cal-grid" x1="55" y1="175" x2="625" y2="175"></line><line class="cal-grid" x1="55" y1="112.5" x2="625" y2="112.5"></line>
          <line class="cal-axis" x1="55" y1="300" x2="625" y2="300"></line><line class="cal-axis" x1="55" y1="50" x2="55" y2="300"></line>

          <text x="45" y="304" text-anchor="end">0%</text><text x="45" y="179" text-anchor="end">50%</text><text x="45" y="54" text-anchor="end">100%</text>
          <text x="55" y="320">0%</text><text x="340" y="320" text-anchor="middle">50%</text><text x="625" y="320" text-anchor="end">100%</text>
          <text x="340" y="338" text-anchor="middle">Predicted Matchup-Win Probability</text><text transform="translate(13 175) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle">Observed Win Rate</text>
        </svg>

def overall_effect_chart():
    rows = []
    max_effect = max(overall_coefficients["coefficient_per_sd"].abs().max(), .01)
    for category in category_order:
        row = overall_coefficients.loc[category]
        coefficient = float(row.coefficient_per_sd)
        width = abs(coefficient) / max_effect * 48
        side = "positive" if coefficient >= 0 else "negative"
        rows.append(f"""<div class="effect-row"><strong>{escape(category)}</strong><div class="effect-track"><i class="{side}" style="width:{width:.1f}%"></i></div><span>{row.odds_ratio_per_sd:.2f}×</span></div>""")
    return '<div class="effect-card"><div class="effect-head"><span>Category</span><span>Conditional Effect on Matchup-Win Odds</span><span>Odds / +1 SD</span></div>' + "".join(rows) + '</div>'

def overall_coefficient_table():
    rows = []
    for category in category_order:
        row = overall_coefficients.loc[category]
        p_label = "<0.001" if row.p_value < .001 else f"{row.p_value:.3f}"
        rows.append(f"""<tr><th>{escape(category)}</th><td>{row.coefficient_per_sd:.3f}</td><td>{row.clustered_se:.3f}</td><td>{row.odds_ratio_per_sd:.3f}</td><td>{row.ci_95_low:.3f}–{row.ci_95_high:.3f}</td><td>{p_label}</td></tr>""")
    return f"""<details class="model-details"><summary>Mathematical Diagnostics</summary><div class="macro-card table-scroll"><table class="model-results-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>Coefficient / SD</th><th>Clustered SE</th><th>Odds Ratio / SD</th><th>95% Odds-Ratio Interval</th><th>P-Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(rows)}</tbody>
    </table></div></details>"""

def team_panel(brand, selected=False):
    team = canonical[canonical["fantasy_team_name"].eq(brand.team_name)].copy()
    panel_id = "team-" + str(brand.fantasy_team_id)
    status_order = {"ACTIVE": 0, "RESERVE": 0, "INJURED_RESERVE": 0, "MINORS": 1}
    team["_status_order"] = team["roster_status"].map(status_order).fillna(0)
    team["nba_team_display"] = team["nba_team"].replace({"PHO":"PHX", "CHO":"CHA", "SA":"SAS", "NO":"NOP", "(N/A)":"", "N/A":""}).fillna("")
    team["_overall_sort"] = pd.to_numeric(team["overall_rating"], errors="coerce").fillna(-1)
    team["_nba_team_sort"] = team["nba_team_display"].replace("", "ZZZ")
    team = team.sort_values(
        ["_status_order", "_overall_sort", "_nba_team_sort", "player_name"],
        ascending=[True, False, True, True],
    )
    per_game = {
        "points":"ppg", "offensive_rebounds":"orpg", "defensive_rebounds":"drpg",
        "assists":"apg", "steals":"spg", "blocks":"bpg", "turnovers":"tpg",
        "plus_minus":"plus_minus_pg",
    }
    valid_games = team["games"].where(team["games"] > 0)
    for source, target in per_game.items():
        team[target] = team[source] / valid_games
    columns = ["eligible_positions", "player_name", "nba_team_display", "games", "minutes", "ts_pct", "two_pct", "three_pct", "ft_pct", "ppg", "orpg", "drpg", "apg", "spg", "bpg", "tpg", "plus_minus_pg", "overall_rating", "player_chemistry"]
    table = team[columns].rename(columns={"eligible_positions":"Pos.", "player_name":"Player", "nba_team_display":"Tm", "games":"GP", "minutes":"MP", "ts_pct":"TS%", "two_pct":"2PT%", "three_pct":"3PT%", "ft_pct":"FT%", "ppg":"PPG", "orpg":"ORPG", "drpg":"DRPG", "apg":"APG", "spg":"SPG", "bpg":"BPG", "tpg":"TPG", "plus_minus_pg":"+/-", "overall_rating":"Ovr", "player_chemistry":"Chemistry"})
    table["GP"] = table["GP"].map(lambda value: number(value, 0))
    for column in ["MP", "PPG", "ORPG", "DRPG", "APG", "SPG", "BPG", "TPG"]:
        table[column] = table[column].map(lambda value: number(value, 1))
    table["+/-"] = table["+/-"].map(signed_number)
    for column in ["TS%", "2PT%", "3PT%", "FT%"]:
        table[column] = table[column].map(percentage)
    rating_map = {
        "MP":"rating_MP", "TS%":"rating_TS%", "2PT%":"rating_2PT%", "3PT%":"rating_3PT%", "FT%":"rating_FT%",
        "PPG":"rating_PTS", "ORPG":"rating_OREB", "DRPG":"rating_DREB", "APG":"rating_AST", "SPG":"rating_STL",
        "BPG":"rating_BLK", "TPG":"rating_TOV", "+/-":"rating_+/-",
    }
    for display_column, rating_column in rating_map.items():
        table[display_column] = [
            projection_with_rating(value, rating)
            for value, rating in zip(table[display_column], team[rating_column])
        ]
    table["Ovr"] = team["overall_rating"].map(overall_rating_pill)
    table["Chemistry"] = team["player_chemistry"].map(chemistry_rating_pill)
    for column in ["Pos.", "Player", "Tm", "GP"]:
        table[column] = table[column].map(lambda value: escape(str(value)) if str(value) else "")
    table_html = table.to_html(index=False, classes="roster-table", border=0, escape=False)
    return f"""
    <section class="team-sheet{' is-selected' if selected else ''}" id="{escape(panel_id)}" data-team="{escape(str(brand.fantasy_team_id))}" style="--primary:{escape(brand.primary_color)};--secondary:{escape(brand.secondary_color)};--team-text:{escape(brand.text_color)};--team-font:'{escape(brand.font_family)}';">
      <header class="team-hero"><div class="team-identity"><img src="{escape(brand.logo_url)}" alt="{escape(brand.team_name)} logo"><div><span>{escape(brand.conference)} Conference · {escape(brand.division)} Division</span><h1>{escape(brand.team_name)}</h1><p>{escape(brand.motto)}</p></div></div></header>
      {team_metric_tiles(brand.fantasy_team_id)}
      <div class="section-label"><span>Roster Projection Board</span></div><div class="table-wrap">{table_html}</div>
      {player_fit_boards(brand.fantasy_team_id)}
      <footer><span>Fantrax ownership + Hashtag Basketball projections</span></footer>
    </section>"""

ARCHETYPE_NAMES = {
    "do_it_all_superstar": "Do-It-All Superstar",
    "star_to_build_around": "Star To Build Around",
    "role_player": "Role Player",
    "specialist": "Specialist",
    "minute_filler": "Minute Filler",
    "negative_player": "Negative Player",
    "bench_warmer": "Bench Warmer",
    "sleeper": "Sleeper",
}

def player_skill_cards(player):
    games = float(player.games) if pd.notna(player.games) and player.games > 0 else None
    projection_columns = {
        "MP": "minutes", "TS%": "ts_pct", "2PT%": "two_pct", "3PT%": "three_pct", "FT%": "ft_pct",
        "PTS": "points", "OREB": "offensive_rebounds", "DREB": "defensive_rebounds", "AST": "assists",
        "STL": "steals", "BLK": "blocks", "TOV": "turnovers", "+/-": "plus_minus",
    }
    cards = []
    for category in category_order:
        raw = player[projection_columns[category]]
        if category in {"TS%", "2PT%", "3PT%", "FT%"}:
            projection = percentage(raw)
        elif category == "MP":
            projection = number(raw, 1)
        elif category == "+/-":
            projection = signed_number(raw / games, 1) if games else ""
        else:
            projection = number(raw / games, 1) if games else ""
        rating = player[f"rating_{category}"]
        width = 0 if pd.isna(rating) else float(rating) * 10
        rating_label = "—" if pd.isna(rating) else f"{float(rating):.1f}"
        cards.append(f"""<article><header><span>{escape(category)}</span><strong>{projection or '—'}</strong></header>
          <div class="player-skill-track"><i style="width:{width:.1f}%"></i></div><footer><span>Category Rating</span><b>{rating_label}</b></footer></article>""")
    overall = player["overall_rating"]
    overall_width = 0 if pd.isna(overall) else float(overall) * 10
    overall_label = "—" if pd.isna(overall) else f"{float(overall):.1f}"
    cards.append(f"""<article class="is-overall"><header><span>Ovr</span><strong>All 13</strong></header>
      <div class="player-skill-track"><i style="width:{overall_width:.1f}%"></i></div><footer><span>Overall Rating</span><b>{overall_label}</b></footer></article>""")
    return '<div class="player-skill-grid">' + "".join(cards) + "</div>"

def player_archetype_scores(profile):
    rows = []
    for key, label in ARCHETYPE_NAMES.items():
        value = getattr(profile, f"score_{key}")
        score = 0 if pd.isna(value) else float(value)
        rows.append(f"""<div class="archetype-score-row"><span>{escape(label)}</span><div><i style="width:{score:.1f}%"></i></div><strong>{score:.1f}</strong></div>""")
    return '<div class="archetype-score-card">' + "".join(rows) + '</div>'

def player_team_fit_table(player_id, current_team_id):
    fits = player_team_chemistry[player_team_chemistry["fantrax_player_id"].eq(str(player_id))].copy()
    fits = fits.sort_values(["team_fit_score", "player_chemistry"], ascending=[False, False])
    rows = []
    for row in fits.itertuples(index=False):
        is_current = str(row.target_team_id) == str(current_team_id)
        marker = '<span class="current-team-badge">Current Team</span>' if is_current else ""
        rows.append(
            f'<tr class="{"is-current-team" if is_current else ""}"><td>{escape(row.target_team_name)} {marker}</td>'
            f'<td>{float(row.player_chemistry):.1f}</td><td>{float(row.team_fit_score):.1f}</td>'
            f'<td>{float(row.skill_impact_pp):+.2f} pp</td><td>{float(row.expected_score_impact):+.1f}</td>'
            f'<td>{float(row.chemistry_impact_pp):+.2f} pp</td></tr>'
        )
    return f"""<div class="player-fit-table-wrap"><table class="player-all-team-fit"><thead><tr><th>Franchise</th><th>Chemistry</th><th>Fit</th><th>Skill Impact</th><th>Score Impact</th><th>Chemistry Impact</th></tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(rows)}</tbody></table></div>{chemistry_fit_notes()}"""

def chemistry_fit_notes():
    return """<div class="chemistry-fit-notes">
      <p><strong>Chemistry</strong><span>0–10 global percentile of the player's change to team chemistry across all 12,150 player-team combinations.</span></p>
      <p><strong>Fit</strong><span>Relative destination score for this player: 65% of the player's within-player Chemistry rank plus 35% of the within-player Skill Impact rank across the 30 teams.</span></p>
      <p><strong>Skill Impact</strong><span>Percentage-point change in the full 13-category model's probability of defeating an average opponent.</span></p>
      <p><strong>Score Impact</strong><span>Change in category-based Expected Score on the 413-point matchup scale.</span></p>
      <p><strong>Chemistry Impact</strong><span>Percentage-point change beyond the category baseline. Positive means the player's category shape works together better than its standalone parts.</span></p>
      <div><strong>Why can the scores look low?</strong> Both Chemistry and Fit are percentile-based, so they measure relative placement—not raw talent. Half of all global Chemistry combinations fall below 5.0, while a player's 30 Fit destinations are intentionally centered near 5. Use Chemistry Impact to see whether the underlying effect is actually positive or negative.</div>
    </div>"""

def player_panel(profile, selected=False):
    player = canonical[canonical["fantrax_player_id"].eq(str(profile.fantrax_player_id))].iloc[0]
    current_team_id = str(profile.fantasy_team_id)
    brand_match = branding[branding["fantasy_team_id"].astype(str).eq(current_team_id)]
    if len(brand_match):
        brand = brand_match.iloc[0]
        primary, secondary, text_color = brand.primary_color, brand.secondary_color, brand.text_color
    else:
        primary, secondary, text_color = "#123a68", "#6f8daa", "#ffffff"
    similar = [name for name in str(profile.similar_players).split(" | ") if name]
    similar_html = "".join(f"<li>{escape(name)}</li>" for name in similar)
    status = str(profile.roster_status).replace("_", " ").title()
    hierarchy = "—" if pd.isna(profile.hierarchical_cluster) else str(int(profile.hierarchical_cluster))
    return f"""<section class="player-sheet{' is-selected' if selected else ''}" data-player="{escape(str(profile.fantrax_player_id))}" style="--primary:{escape(primary)};--secondary:{escape(secondary)};--team-text:{escape(text_color)}">
      <header class="player-profile-hero"><div><span>{escape(str(profile.fantasy_team_name))} · {escape(status)}</span><h1>{escape(profile.player_name)}</h1><p>{escape(str(profile.eligible_positions))} · {escape(str(profile.nba_team))}</p></div><div class="player-archetype-identity"><small>Player Archetype</small><strong>{escape(profile.archetype_label)}</strong><span>Ward Branch {hierarchy}</span></div></header>
      <div class="player-profile-body">
        <div class="player-profile-heading"><div><small>Projected Skill Profile</small><h3>Skills Across All 13 Categories</h3></div></div>
        {player_skill_cards(player)}
        <div class="player-profile-columns">
          <section><div class="player-profile-heading compact"><div><small>Fuzzy Membership</small><h3>Eight Archetype Scores</h3></div></div>{player_archetype_scores(profile)}</section>
          <section class="similarity-card"><div class="player-profile-heading compact"><div><small>Hierarchical Clustering</small><h3>Closest Statistical Neighbors</h3></div></div><div class="branch-number"><span>Ward Branch</span><strong>{hierarchy}</strong></div><ol>{similar_html}</ol><p>Nearest-player similarity: <strong>{float(profile.closest_similarity):.1f}%</strong></p></section>
        </div>
        <div class="player-profile-heading"><div><small>Roster Context</small><h3>Chemistry Fit Across All 30 Teams</h3></div></div>
        {player_team_fit_table(profile.fantrax_player_id, current_team_id)}
      </div>
    </section>"""

def player_payload(profile):
    player = canonical[canonical["fantrax_player_id"].eq(str(profile.fantrax_player_id))].iloc[0]
    current_team_id = str(profile.fantasy_team_id)
    brand_match = branding[branding["fantasy_team_id"].astype(str).eq(current_team_id)]
    if len(brand_match):
        brand = brand_match.iloc[0]
        colors = {"primary": brand.primary_color, "secondary": brand.secondary_color, "text": brand.text_color}
    else:
        colors = {"primary": "#123a68", "secondary": "#6f8daa", "text": "#ffffff"}
    games = float(player.games) if pd.notna(player.games) and player.games > 0 else None
    projection_columns = {
        "MP": "minutes", "TS%": "ts_pct", "2PT%": "two_pct", "3PT%": "three_pct", "FT%": "ft_pct",
        "PTS": "points", "OREB": "offensive_rebounds", "DREB": "defensive_rebounds", "AST": "assists",
        "STL": "steals", "BLK": "blocks", "TOV": "turnovers", "+/-": "plus_minus",
    }
    skills = []
    for category in category_order:
        raw = player[projection_columns[category]]
        if category in {"TS%", "2PT%", "3PT%", "FT%"}:
            projection = percentage(raw)
        elif category == "MP":
            projection = number(raw, 1)
        elif category == "+/-":
            projection = signed_number(raw / games, 1) if games else ""
        else:
            projection = number(raw / games, 1) if games else ""
        rating = player[f"rating_{category}"]
        skills.append({"category": category, "projection": projection or "—", "rating": None if pd.isna(rating) else round(float(rating), 1), "overall": False})
    skills.append({"category": "Ovr", "projection": "All 13", "rating": round(float(profile.overall_rating), 1), "overall": True})
    specialist_active = profile.primary_archetype == "Specialist" or profile.secondary_archetype == "Specialist"
    specialist_type = str(profile.specialist_subtype) if specialist_active else ""
    scores = [
        {"label": specialist_type if key == "specialist" and specialist_active else label, "score": round(float(getattr(profile, f"score_{key}")), 1)}
        for key, label in ARCHETYPE_NAMES.items()
    ]
    fits = player_team_chemistry[player_team_chemistry["fantrax_player_id"].eq(str(profile.fantrax_player_id))].copy()
    fits = fits.sort_values(["team_fit_score", "player_chemistry"], ascending=[False, False])
    fit_records = [
        {
            "team": row.target_team_name,
            "current": str(row.target_team_id) == current_team_id,
            "chemistry": round(float(row.player_chemistry), 1),
            "fit": round(float(row.team_fit_score), 1),
            "skill": round(float(row.skill_impact_pp), 2),
            "score": round(float(row.expected_score_impact), 1),
            "chemistry_impact": round(float(row.chemistry_impact_pp), 2),
        }
        for row in fits.itertuples(index=False)
    ]
    teammate_rows = player_teammate_chemistry[
        player_teammate_chemistry["fantrax_player_id"].eq(str(profile.fantrax_player_id))
    ].sort_values("pair_chemistry_impact_pp")
    if len(teammate_rows):
        least_teammate = teammate_rows.iloc[0]
        favorite_teammate = teammate_rows.iloc[-1]
        teammate_fit = {
            "favorite": {
                "name": favorite_teammate["teammate_name"],
                "impact": round(float(favorite_teammate["pair_chemistry_impact_pp"]), 2),
            },
            "least": {
                "name": least_teammate["teammate_name"],
                "impact": round(float(least_teammate["pair_chemistry_impact_pp"]), 2),
            },
        }
    else:
        teammate_fit = {"favorite": {"name": "—", "impact": 0}, "least": {"name": "—", "impact": 0}}
    return {
        "id": str(profile.fantrax_player_id), "name": profile.player_name,
        "fantasy_team": str(profile.fantasy_team_name), "status": str(profile.roster_status).replace("_", " ").title(),
        "positions": str(profile.eligible_positions), "nba_team": str(profile.nba_team),
        "archetype": profile.archetype_label, "specialist_type": specialist_type, "cluster": int(profile.hierarchical_cluster),
        "overall": round(float(profile.overall_rating), 1), "similarity": round(float(profile.closest_similarity), 1),
        "similar": [name for name in str(profile.similar_players).split(" | ") if name],
        "colors": colors, "skills": skills, "scores": scores, "fits": fit_records,
        "teammates": teammate_fit,
    }

team_id_by_name = canonical[["fantasy_team_id", "fantasy_team_name"]].drop_duplicates().set_index("fantasy_team_name")["fantasy_team_id"]
branding["fantasy_team_id"] = branding["team_name"].map(team_id_by_name)
branding = branding[branding["fantasy_team_id"].notna()].sort_values("team_name")
default_team_id = str(branding.loc[branding["team_name"].eq("Vegas Blackjack"), "fantasy_team_id"].iloc[0])
options = "".join(f'<option value="{escape(str(row.fantasy_team_id))}"{" selected" if str(row.fantasy_team_id) == default_team_id else ""}>{escape(row.team_name)}</option>' for row in branding.itertuples(index=False))
panels = "".join(team_panel(row, str(row.fantasy_team_id) == default_team_id) for row in branding.itertuples(index=False))
projected_archetypes = player_archetypes[player_archetypes["archetype_label"].ne("Unrated")].sort_values("player_name")
default_player_id = str(projected_archetypes.loc[projected_archetypes["player_name"].eq("Nikola Jokic"), "fantrax_player_id"].iloc[0])
player_options = "".join(
    f'<option value="{escape(str(row.fantrax_player_id))}"{" selected" if str(row.fantrax_player_id) == default_player_id else ""}>{escape(row.player_name)} · {escape(str(row.fantasy_team_name))}</option>'
    for row in projected_archetypes.itertuples(index=False)
)
player_data_json = json.dumps(
    {str(row.fantrax_player_id): player_payload(row) for row in projected_archetypes.itertuples(index=False)},
    ensure_ascii=False,
).replace("</", "<\\/")
player_app_script = r"""
<script>
(function(){
  const selector=document.getElementById('player-selector');
  const root=document.getElementById('player-profile-root');
  const players=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('player-data').textContent);
  const esc=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
  const signed=(value,digits=2)=>`${value>=0?'+':''}${Number(value).toFixed(digits)}`;
  function render(){
    const p=players[selector.value];
    const favoriteClass=p.teammates.favorite.impact>=0?'positive':'negative';
    const leastClass=p.teammates.least.impact>=0?'positive':'negative';
    const skills=p.skills.map(item=>`<article class="${item.overall?'is-overall':''}"><header><span>${esc(item.category)}</span><strong>${esc(item.projection)}</strong></header><div class="player-skill-track"><i style="width:${item.rating===null?0:item.rating*10}%"></i></div><footer><span>${item.overall?'Overall Rating':'Category Rating'}</span><b>${item.rating===null?'—':item.rating.toFixed(1)}</b></footer></article>`).join('');
    const scores=p.scores.map(item=>`<div class="archetype-score-row"><span>${esc(item.label)}</span><div><i style="width:${item.score}%"></i></div><strong>${item.score.toFixed(1)}</strong></div>`).join('');
    const similar=p.similar.map(name=>`<li>${esc(name)}</li>`).join('');
    const fits=p.fits.map(item=>`<tr class="${item.current?'is-current-team':''}"><td>${esc(item.team)} ${item.current?'<span class="current-team-badge">Current Team</span>':''}</td><td>${item.chemistry.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${item.fit.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${signed(item.skill)} pp</td><td>${signed(item.score,1)}</td><td>${signed(item.chemistry_impact)} pp</td></tr>`).join('');
    root.innerHTML=`<section class="player-sheet is-selected" style="--primary:${esc(p.colors.primary)};--secondary:${esc(p.colors.secondary)};--team-text:${esc(p.colors.text)}">
      <header class="player-profile-hero"><div><span>${esc(p.fantasy_team)} · ${esc(p.status)}</span><h1>${esc(p.name)}</h1><p>${esc(p.positions)} · ${esc(p.nba_team)}</p></div><div class="player-archetype-identity"><small>Player Archetype</small><strong>${esc(p.archetype)}</strong>${p.specialist_type?`<em>${esc(p.specialist_type)}</em>`:''}<span>Ward Branch ${p.cluster}</span></div></header>
      <div class="player-profile-body"><div class="player-profile-heading"><div><small>Projected Skill Profile</small><h3>Skills Across All 13 Categories</h3></div></div><div class="player-skill-grid">${skills}</div>
      <div class="player-profile-columns"><section><div class="player-profile-heading compact"><div><small>Fuzzy Membership</small><h3>Eight Archetype Scores</h3></div></div><div class="archetype-score-card">${scores}</div></section>
      <section class="similarity-card"><div class="player-profile-heading compact"><div><small>Hierarchical Clustering</small><h3>Closest Statistical Neighbors</h3></div></div><div class="branch-number"><span>Ward Branch</span><strong>${p.cluster}</strong></div><ol>${similar}</ol><p>Nearest-player similarity: <strong>${p.similarity.toFixed(1)}%</strong></p></section>
      <section class="teammate-card"><div class="player-profile-heading compact"><div><small>Pairwise Chemistry</small><h3>Teammate Fit</h3></div></div><div class="teammate-list"><div class="teammate-row"><span>Favorite</span><div><strong>${esc(p.teammates.favorite.name)}</strong><b class="${favoriteClass}">${signed(p.teammates.favorite.impact)} pp</b></div></div><div class="teammate-row"><span>Least Favorite</span><div><strong>${esc(p.teammates.least.name)}</strong><b class="${leastClass}">${signed(p.teammates.least.impact)} pp</b></div></div></div><p>Interaction beyond each player's standalone effect.</p></section></div>
      <div class="player-profile-heading"><div><small>Roster Context</small><h3>Chemistry Fit Across All 30 Teams</h3></div></div><div class="player-fit-table-wrap"><table class="player-all-team-fit"><thead><tr><th>Franchise</th><th>Chemistry</th><th>Fit</th><th>Skill Impact</th><th>Score Impact</th><th>Chemistry Impact</th></tr></thead><tbody>${fits}</tbody></table></div>
      <div class="chemistry-fit-notes"><p><strong>Chemistry</strong><span>0–10 global percentile of the player's change to team chemistry across all 12,150 player-team combinations.</span></p><p><strong>Fit</strong><span>Relative destination score: 65% of this player's within-player Chemistry rank plus 35% of the within-player Skill Impact rank across 30 teams.</span></p><p><strong>Skill Impact</strong><span>Percentage-point change in the full model's chance of defeating an average opponent.</span></p><p><strong>Score Impact</strong><span>Change in category-based Expected Score on the 413-point scale.</span></p><p><strong>Chemistry Impact</strong><span>Percentage-point change beyond the category baseline; positive means the player's category shape creates additional synergy.</span></p><div><strong>Why can the scores look low?</strong> Chemistry and Fit are percentile-based, not talent grades.     const url=new URL(window.location.href);url.searchParams.set('player',selector.value);window.history.replaceState({},'',url);

})();

### Counting Category Win Models

Nine separate logistic regressions estimate the probability that a team wins each counting category. Every historical team performance is standardized to a **24.93-NBA-game period** before modeling. The line is the fitted probability; dots show observed win rates within twelve equally populated performance bands. The dashed vertical line marks the projected total associated with a 50% chance of winning that category against a random historical opponent.

```{python}

```

```{python}
display(HTML(counting_model_results_table()))
```

Standard errors are clustered by SBCFBL matchup because the two opposing team observations are paired. Tied category results are excluded. The odds ratio is the multiplicative change in win odds associated with one additional standardized category unit; for TOV, values below 1.00 correctly indicate that additional turnovers reduce the chance of winning.

### Shooting Category Win Models

The four shooting categories use **points gained**, which gives efficiency the volume it deserves:

$$\text{Points Gained} = (\text{Team \%} - \text{Season League-Average \%}) \times \text{Attempts}$$

For 2PT%, 3PT%, and FT%, attempts are 2PA, 3PA, and FTA. For TS%, attempts use its full scoring denominator, $2 \times (\text{FGA} + 0.44 \times \text{FTA})$, so TS points gained measures actual points scored above or below league-average true-shooting efficiency at the same volume. Each team-period value is then adjusted to 24.93 NBA games. A value near zero is league average; positive values helped the category and negative values hurt it.

The line is the fitted probability of winning the category. The dots are the actual historical win rates in twelve equally populated points-gained bands—not individual teams or players.

```{python}
display(HTML(shooting_model_cards()))
```

```{python}
display(HTML(shooting_model_results_table()))
```

The 50% marks landing near zero are an important validation: a team producing almost exactly league-average efficiency at its own shot volume should be close to a coin flip against a random historical opponent.

### Overall Matchup-Win Model

This model combines **all 13 categories at once** to estimate the probability that a team wins the full matchup. The nine counting totals and four shooting points-gained metrics are standardized to a 24.93-NBA-game period, then standardized again to one historical standard deviation so their conditional effects can be compared on the same scale.

```{python}
display(HTML(overall_model_visual()))
```

#### Plain-English Category Effects

The chart answers: **holding the other 12 inputs constant, how do the matchup-win odds change when this category improves by one historical standard deviation?** A value above `1.00×` increases the odds; below `1.00×` decreases them. TOV correctly runs in the opposite direction. These are conditional effects, so overlapping shooting measures can look smaller here than in their standalone category-win models.

```{python}
display(HTML(overall_effect_chart()))
```

The mathematical form is $P(\text{matchup win}) = \operatorname{logit}^{-1}(\beta_0 + \beta_1x_1 + \cdots + \beta_{13}x_{13})$. Coefficients use standardized inputs, and clustered standard errors preserve the paired structure of each matchup.

```{python}
display(HTML(overall_coefficient_table()))
```

### Season-Based Model Backtesting

Model diagnostics above describe fit on the complete historical dataset. This backtest asks the harder question: **how well does each model perform on a season it has never seen?** For each of the six completed seasons, the model is trained on the other five and used to predict every team result in the excluded season. The pooled scores below therefore contain only out-of-sample predictions.

```{python}
display(HTML(season_backtest_visual()))
```

**AUC** measures whether winners receive higher probabilities than losers; 0.50 is random and 1.00 is perfect ranking. **Brier score** and **log loss** measure probability accuracy and are lower-is-better. **Calibration error** is the observation-weighted gap between predicted and actual win rates across ten probability bands. Season ranges matter because a strong pooled result can still conceal a model that behaves inconsistently from year to year.

Each cell shows how often the same team won both categories when neither category was tied. This is a historical co-win rate—not a Pearson correlation of raw totals. Darker blue indicates categories that travel together; red indicates categories that more often split between opponents.

### Player Archetypes and Hierarchical Similarity

The league-level models describe value one category at a time. This final section turns those outputs into a map of **player identity**. Every projected player receives eight continuous membership scores rather than being forced into one rigid bucket. A player receives a single label when one identity clearly dominates; when two identities are comparably strong, the ordered primary/secondary combination is used. That creates **64 possible core labels**—eight single archetypes plus 56 ordered two-archetype combinations—although only combinations supported by the projection pool appear.

Do-It-All Superstar is deliberately exclusive: only the seven most valuable players with at least seven category strengths receive it, and it is always their only label. Specialists receive a separate K-means subtype describing whether their concentrated value is primarily shooting, scoring, playmaking, defense, or interior production.

Ward hierarchical clustering is calculated independently of those names. It blends the 13 model-based category ratings with projected season totals and per-36 production. The 12-branch cut powers the comparable-player results on the Players page; it discovers statistical neighborhoods without dictating a player's named archetype.
